Class AlreadyRegisteredException

  • java.lang.Object
    • java.lang.Throwable
      • java.lang.Exception
        • fr.sorbonne_u.exceptions.VerboseException

            • fr.sorbonne_u.cps.pubsub.exceptions.AlreadyRegisteredException
  • All Implemented Interfaces:
    java.io.Serializable

    public class AlreadyRegisteredException
extends fr.sorbonne_u.components.exceptions.BCMException
    The class AlreadyRegisteredException implements the exception thrown when a component tries to register to the system but the provided identifier has already been registered on the system.
